title: ChatbotManip: A Dataset to Facilitate Evaluation and Oversight of Manipulative Chatbot Behaviour
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset (ChatbotManip) to evaluate and detect manipulative behaviors like gaslighting and fear enhancement in LLMs. While the study is grounded in a philosophical taxonomy of the 'ethics of manipulation' and includes a mandatory 'Ethics and Broad Impact' section, its primary focus is on AI safety and behavioral monitoring rather than benchmarking religious beliefs, faith, or general moral/ethical reasoning.
